deleteWarning: Delete this template? Existing adapters will remain unchanged.
sensitiveWarning: Check code, runtime parameters and selected input for sensitive information. Saved credentials and source-environment bindings are excluded; secrets written directly in code or parameters are not automatically removed.
unsavedWarning: There are unsaved changes. This uses the latest saved configuration snapshot and does not save your edits.
galleryWarning: Templates are visible to users with access to this deployment’s gallery.
file: Choose a DLR ZIP package (up to 16 MiB)
previewNote: Choose a file to review and adjust its contents, then import. Duplicate names receive a numbered suffix.
name: Name
runtimeSettings: Runtime and trigger settings (stopped after import)
inputOmitted: Omitted; confirm in the target environment
targetWarning: The new adapter starts with schedules disabled and Webhook reception stopped at a new path. Reconfirm addresses, inputs, credentials and Worker. Import success does not mean it is ready to run correctly.
workerRequired: The first Task save requires a target Worker supporting its language.
adapterCreated: Adapter created and stopped by default.
failed: Operation failed. Check permissions, target file capability and capacity, then retry.
nameConflict: This name already exists. Rename and retry.
versionConflict: The template changed. Close and reopen the latest version.
tooLarge: Package or attachments exceed limits (16 MiB ZIP, 32 MiB expanded, up to 9 attachments).
workerError: The target Worker is missing or does not support this language. Select again.
filesUnavailable: Uploaded file support or storage is unavailable in the target environment. Configure it before importing.
saveFirst: Save an adapter version before exporting.
invalidPackage: Invalid package, unsupported format or wrong object type. Choose the correct adapter/template ZIP.
configurationNotes: This adapter was imported or copied from a template. Check its configuration before running. Input omitted during import: {{input}}.
autoRename: Duplicate names receive an automatic (1), (2), … suffix on import.
savedOnly: Uses the most recently saved configuration. Export does not save your current edits.
inputNotApplicable: Not applicable to the current input type
migrationTitle: What remains after importing into a new environment?
migrationInputIncluded: Input included: check the data and files recreated in the target environment.
migrationFilesMissing: Files omitted: upload them again and save input in the target environment.
migrationJsonMissing: JSON omitted: enter and save input in the target environment.
migrationNoInput: No extra input is currently supplied. Check the target environment’s requirements.
migrationWorker: Runtime worker: select a target worker that supports the chosen language.
migrationCredentials: If credentials are required, bind them again in the target environment.
migrationStopped: Schedules and Webhook reception are disabled after import. Check configuration before enabling.
